feature: Ghost Samurai paired strikes, grid follow-up, late aim locks and Phase2 pressure
scope: Ghost Samurai rules/runtime/forecast geometry and focused tests; protocol increment for the added full slash-aim state. Preserve the phase enum/state machine, native damage values, summon identity, exact-Fight cleanup and original artwork. Current main's Doll/Luminance changes were retained via a normal merge into the feature branch; main itself was not modified.

environment.dependency_note: Versions read from installed package headers; copies exist only in ignored compiler profile. Luminance is inherited from integrated main, not introduced by this mechanic.

directional.current: 4 pairs / 8 strikes; 12 ticks within each pair and 36 ticks from a pair's second hit to the next pair

dash.geometry: Retreat tracks the target until lock; direction may be diagonal. At lock the actor stops and the final start/end govern both forecast/collision and subsequent movement.

wisps.burst_opportunities: Alternate 1 then 2 bursts across base opportunities. One directional pair replaces one former slash opportunity, giving 6 bursts per four-pair sequence; charge/grid patterns retain one base opportunity each rather than multiplying again per added charge strike.
wisps.limit: The cap overrides requested count when prior live/reserved wisps remain, so actual crowded-field spawning can be below the theoretical 1.5 multiplier.
wisps.unchanged_motion: 30 ticks outward at 3.5px/tick, then 180 ticks homing toward 4.5px/tick with strength 0.035; harmless during spread.

authority_and_replication.identity: Immutable hazard shape/times, Fight GUID and exact boss slot retained
authority_and_replication.aim: 24-byte full SamuraiSlashAim containing tick, lock tick, position and unit direction; populated in OnSpawn before initial native synchronization
authority_and_replication.updates: Every 3 ticks while tracking plus final lock; clients display accepted geometry verbatim and do not aim or determine damage
authority_and_replication.rejection: Parse/validate completely before applying; reject stale ticks, same-tick conflicting geometry, changed lock schedules or hazard identity, malformed values and wrong owner/Fight; no client authority
authority_and_replication.late_join: A final full locked snapshot repairs missing intermediate updates. Until final lock arrives, clients do not draw an obsolete line as a live strike.
authority_and_replication.cleanup: Existing exact-Fight scan and slot/instance ownership retained; aimed-projectile reference cleared on finish/phase cleanup/abandon/terminal path
authority_and_replication.clock: Display snapshot reports the evaluated attack tick rather than the incremented next-tick cursor

focused_domain.scope: Eight-hit schedule, pose continuity, charge triple timing, grid/player clearance for 1-4 players, lock and dodge boundaries, wisp burst multiplier/caps, phase/selection and malformed/stale/full-state codecs

checks.reuse: No linked domain/codec inputs or Ghost Samurai registration types changed during the later main merges. Passing tests and 0.2.65 type validation were reused; native packaging repeated to retain current main Luminance materials and advance the feature version.

native_build.mode: tools/dev.py build --native with explicit isolated compiler-output profile
native_build.subsequent_changes: Owning specification, status, evidence and generated catalog only; no runtime or asset edits after this build

packaged_type_validation.limitation: Installed loader ValidateType only; no full Mod autoload or graphics initialization

checks.workspace: New worktree from current main at task start; previous worktrees and their dirty files untouched. Shared package SHA256 remained 37b49b57131e6837c77006da714061207bed3688892875d081f8906c7ac5d8d5; its old version is not the final artifact. ModSources junction, personal enabled-Mod list and saves were not changed.

runtime.real_equipment_and_latency: not_run: geometric tests assume immediate perpendicular motion at 8px/tick or a 14px/tick dash. They do not establish a particular Calamity accessory's acceleration/cooldown, a latency guarantee or in-game FPS.

handoff: Review/merge into main when requested, then build/install the integrated protocol31 package for every peer. Reload Mods/restart without a duplicate Build + Reload. Verify paired rhythm, immediate post-grid dodge, late-lock charge/dash evasion, the held third Phase2 charge, wisp pressure and phase/terminal cleanup.
